rule: No unproved imported input counts as full unconditional paper coverage. Availability not established is not a claim of absence.

inputs.title: Finite graph/path/set/arithmetic foundations
inputs.acceptance: Lean/Mathlib exact pinned declarations; do not assume matching representation or cost.

inputs.title: Word-RAM or equivalent explicit operational and live-space model
inputs.acceptance: Fixed program and charged primitives; no arbitrary cost oracle.

inputs.title: Constructed DAG dominator tree, LCA and Euler index
inputs.acceptance: Soft-linear construction is sufficient for first release; existence is not construction cost.

inputs.title: Topological ordering, residual SCCs and rank propagation
inputs.acceptance: General residual digraph may cycle; account for each original/residual arc.

inputs.title: Bounded integral max flow, cut certificate and two-path decomposition
inputs.acceptance: Three searches, reverse arcs and protected capacity-three gates charged.

inputs.title: Deterministic immutable tuple balanced dictionary
inputs.acceptance: Comparison costs include tuple length; no expected hash-map bound.

inputs.title: Exact linear dominators BGK+08
inputs.acceptance: Binary lifting or an abstract tree is insufficient for literal O(G).

inputs.title: Constructed independent/divergent spanning trees GT15
inputs.acceptance: Supplied-tree localization and constructed-tree algorithm are separate claims.

inputs.title: General directed k-failure preserver / improved anti-isolation BCR18 HSW25
inputs.acceptance: Allow cycles; keep consequences conditional until the source theorem is proved/imported.

inputs.title: Finite-field polynomial zero test and matrix arithmetic model
inputs.acceptance: One-sided total error and word/bit arithmetic costs explicit.

inputs.title: Literal conjectures and algorithm-class transfer contracts
inputs.acceptance: Named assumptions may remain; construction/closure theorems must be proved, especially combinatorial class.

inputs.title: Paper A exact physical/detector/native interfaces
inputs.acceptance: Use each full pin and declaration list in reuse-audit.json; no moving head.

inputs.title: Range reporting, streaming chain validation and dynamic LCA primitives
inputs.acceptance: Charge construction, p graph passes, retained targets and implicit fixed-parent queries.

inputs.title: Greedy overlapping path cover and chain-width equivalence
inputs.acceptance: Re-derive maximum-uncovered-path DP, decay bound and linear-storage assigned subsequences; no supplied kappa or transitive-closure oracle.

inputs.title: Primal-dual weighted cover and resource composition
inputs.acceptance: Prove residual-weight feasibility, tight selected vertices and factor two; charge graph/weight discovery for fixed independent trees.
